paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6.
In Vayikra Rabbah 36:6 Rabbi Berekhyah bar Chelbo spoke in his name. Hyman explains that the name had been written רב״א and identifies him as R’ Ba bar Zavda.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6 paragraph reads Rava bar Zavda; Vayikra Rabbah 36:6 names Rabbi Berekhyah bar Chelbo speaking in Rava bar Zavda’s name. Hyman’s explanation involving the written abbreviation רב״א and his proposed Ba bar Zavda reading remain attributed, without a verified letter-loss history or identity admission.
